description: A tall dark cup sits on the table in front of you, with a clear plastic water bottle beside it. The right hand reaches forward to grasp the bottle, lifting and tilting it over the cup while the left hand slides in to steady the cup as water is poured inside, then the right hand tips the bottle back upright and lowers it next to the cup while the left hand keeps hold briefly. There’s a spill risk while the bottle is tilted over the cup.
